name: Divine Intervention
source:
The Elven Empress Elizara has declared war. Not just on the beastlings of Morak, but our home of Veskar. Her invasion of our home has been ruthless, bloody, and shows no signs of stopping. Men and women, entire families - none are spared from spell or steel in the Valanorian death march. We will not allow this heartless bloodshed to continue unchecked.

Defend your home.

Become greater.

Join the ACA.

[From [url=https://sondertalesstudios.itch.io/divine-intervention]Itch.io[/url]]
